title: Collection
description: A versioned set of entries of one type, the unit of sync with the future API.

version.description: Bumped by hand whenever the content changes.

Source.description: Where a value comes from in the rulebook.

page.description: Printed page number (PDF page minus one).

Specialty.description:
A suggested specialty of a skill taken per specialty (a language, an instrument). Only a
suggestion: the sheet also accepts any text the GM types (p. 45 allows a language that is not
in the list). The sheet stores `skill:code`, or `skill:text` for a typed one.

skill.description: Skill `id` it belongs to (a skill with `specialty: true`).
